name: xkeen-manager
title: XKeen Manager
description: Manage the xkeen (Xray) proxy client on Keenetic routers over SSH: status, server profiles, routing rules, backups and health checks
author: vbrs

commands.name: xkeen-manager
commands.title: XKeen Manager
commands.description: Status, restart and logs for xkeen

commands.name: menubar-status
commands.title: XKeen Menu Bar
commands.description: XKeen status in the menu bar with quick actions

preferences.name: proxyTag
preferences.title: Proxy Outbound Tag
preferences.description: Outbound tag for proxy rules created by Quick Add. Leave empty to auto-detect from 04_outbounds.json

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Status
tools.description: Get current xkeen status, mode, active profile and router health (/opt, disk, xkeen binary)

tools.name: list-profiles
tools.title: List Profiles
tools.description: List available xkeen server profiles and show which one is active

tools.name: switch-profile
tools.title: Switch Profile
tools.description: Switch xkeen to another server profile and restart it

tools.name: add-domains
tools.title: Add Domains
tools.description: Add domains, keywords or geosite/geoip entries to xkeen routing

ai.instructions: This extension manages xkeen (Xray) on a Keenetic router over SSH. Use get-status and list-profiles freely for read-only checks. switch-profile and add-domains change the router configuration, so only call them when the user explicitly asks for it, and let Raycast's confirmation dialog run before applying the change.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
